Gitboard provides a local dashboard for managing GitLab and GitHub workflows, integrating CI status, merge requests, and local worktree states via `gh`, `glab`, and `git` binaries.
The tool operates through a lifecycle of initialization (`gitboard init`), data synchronization (`gitboard sync`), and local serving (`gitboard serve`).
